$Comment: Sawyer Marn, standing in the Forgotten Temple beside the Rootling merchant's spawn marker,
across from the Mastery Trainer. Marn is this pack's character end to end: his role, this
placement and the conversation pressing F opens all ship here, so a server without the pack
has no sawyer to stand up. Interact names a conversation rather than a screen because Marn
has quests to hand out and lines to say before any list opens; a screen name there would open
that screen with no conversation at all. Author Open or Dialogue, never both.
To take Marn out without editing this file, set Enabled false in
mods/ziggfreedcommon/npc-placements.json.
Where targets the temple by its GameplayConfig key rather than by name: that key is the
engine's own per-world gameplay-config id ('ForgottenTemple' ships with the base game) and
it is the same every time the temple is entered, while the world NAME carries a fresh uuid
each time.
Requires keeps Marn away until the stations feature is on, which means RPG Stations is
installed and switched on; with it off his quests do not exist either, so nothing dangles.
Lifecycle keeps his chunk loaded, puts him back if something removes him, and raises his
health beyond anything that can be dealt. All three matter for a quest giver: a delivery
quest whose character is not standing where the player is parks unpaid until they find him.
This placement authors no Identity.NpcId, so the character IS his role: the Sawmill quests
bind to Mmo_Sawyer, and any second placement of that role is the same sawyer, offering and
taking hand-ins for the same quests.
Marn stands beside the temple's own Rootling Merchant spawn marker rather than at the raw
portal-landing point, so he moves with the temple's actual layout instead of an offset that
can land inside a wall. The Mastery Trainer anchors to the same marker on the positive X side,
so Marn takes the negative side. To move him, edit Anchor.Structure.Offset, keeping it small
enough to stay out of the walls, and Yaw to turn which way he faces. /mmonpc list
--arg1=structures shows the marker ids the engine has seen when an anchor resolves nothing.
Name: Mmo_Sawyer_Temple
